I've replied to Dana in your direct message with two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers from Moss's notes:

- **#PD-4492**: from Moss's "Sunday prep for Ruth" note, dated 5 Oct 2025. Thea Ramaswell opened it on 4 Oct because drivers checking in at the Eau Claire yard (Dock Doors 14–18) weren't getting text messages with their bay assignments. Support fixed it that day, and Thea confirmed on 5 Oct that it worked.
- **#4419**: from Moss's North cheat sheet, which has no date. It covers gatehouse barcode scanners not reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. It was passed to the second-level support team to test scanner firmware.

The two numbers look alike but describe different problems, so I listed them as separate tickets. I checked all six of Moss's notes in the shared files. Two other North notes mention the account but give no ticket number. I left out Marcus's note on Quarendon Freightways, a different company that isn't a customer. I didn't find any Moss posts in #general or #help-it-ops, the two channels Dana and Moss share.

Ticket numbers aren't money terms, and Dana is on the account's team, so no approval was needed. I only used sources Dana can see herself.
